cluster_thesis.text: The equipment/on-site layer of this cluster (GEV turbines+grid gear, BE behind-the-meter fuel cells, VRT liquid cooling) is genuinely strengthening with multi-year contracted backlog and pricing power. The grid-connected/merchant-IPP and policy-driven layers (VST, FSLR) are watch-status and mixed. Liquid cooling being called 'the default for new AI datacenter designs' and gas-turbine slots already >50% booked into 2031 both signal a maturing, not early-stage, infrastructure cycle.
cluster_thesis.falsifier: GEV's 2026-10-21 print shows gas-turbine or electrification backlog conversion stalling, or a second hyperscaler after Vistra publicly backs a demand pause/interconnection moratorium.

margin_pool.moving_toward: on-site/behind-the-meter generation (BE) and locked-in multi-year equipment contracts (GEV turbines, VRT liquid cooling) where suppliers hold pricing power
margin_pool.moving_away_from: grid-connected merchant-IPP monetization (VST) where interconnection queues and local permitting/political friction (Texas pause) are becoming binding constraints
